content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works well, but the footer opens with an oversized three-line farm name that repeats the name again directly beneath it, and the hero's text-link CTAs are weak.","desktopNote":"In the Nastanitev section the apartment card is stretched to the height of the photo card and sits two-thirds empty, leaving a big dead band in the grid.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Give the apartment card its own photo (or let cards size to content) so the desktop accommodation grid has no empty half-card.","Replace the plain underlined text links in the hero and booking CTA with one clear primary button (Rezervirajte) and a secondary link; drop the repeated 'Navodila za pot'.","Shrink the footer wordmark to the header size and remove the duplicated name line; tighten the footer into a two-column block."],"blockers":["Desktop, Nastanitev: the 'Apartma za 4 osebe' card is stretched to match the photo card and shows a large empty area.","Phone, footer: the farm name appears as a giant three-line heading and is repeated verbatim immediately below it."]}
